meta.rule: Never chain across bases or measures. A share of GSDP is a state's own budget figure over budget_boundary[state][base][year], on one base; show the break wherever a chart crosses a segment boundary.
meta.budget_boundary: GSDP on the territory of the state's budget that year. Equal to the printed series except where a back-cast puts the parent on its post-split boundary before the successor had a budget; there it is parent + successor, both as printed on the same base.
meta.known_issue: data/reference/state_gsdp.json, which feeds data/states.json, pairs undivided Andhra Pradesh budgets for 2011-12 to 2013-14 with residual Andhra Pradesh GSDP (Telangana is back-cast from 2011-12). budget_boundary here is the corrected denominator.
notes: *: For the years 2011-12 till 2018-19, figures relate to Jammu and Kashmir & Ladakh and for the years 2019-20 to 2024-25, relate to UT of Jammu and Kashmir.
Source: National Statistical Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India.
